name: Ink Swell, One Crest
description: A single long crest of deep water seen from above rises out of an ink-navy field, lit faintly as if by a moon you cannot see, and through the day it travels up the wall, broadens and gathers the hours' music as faint tide marks below it.
listening: Bass breath swells the crest's width like a slow tide, rising tension tightens and lifts its lit edge, the key leans the steel highlight cooler or warmer, treble softens or sharpens the sheen, and each hour's energy leaves a faint tide line beneath the wave.

curator.verdict: A calm, on-brief ink-navy field with one faint steel-blue crest that climbs and broadens through the day, clearly different from the recent warm-on-black pieces. The ground reads as a true deep colour and the crest is luminous without neon, so I would hang it.

post.caption: Today was a quiet one, with no music filling the room. The crest of deep ink-blue water rests calmly, barely changing, reflecting the stillness and silence that stretched through every hour. It carries only the faintest trace of an unheard tide beneath it.
post.alt: A single broad crest of deep navy-blue water gently illuminated, stretching horizontally across a dark blue field with no visible movement.
